mcp.title: Talk to this site
mcp.lede: Every article, project and role here is readable by an AI client as tools rather than as pages. Point yours at the endpoint below.
mcp.step1: Open your client's settings: Claude Desktop, Cursor, or anything that speaks MCP.
mcp.step2: Add a remote MCP server and paste the URL.
mcp.step3Example: "what has Lincoli written about Go worker pools?"
mcp.foot: Five tools: search the writing, read one piece in full, list it by tag, list the projects, read the profile. Nothing to install, nothing to sign in to.
